exact_target_semantics.finding: The current Ordinary contract deliberately distinguishes source identity from whole-prayer word identity. The source remains the 1862 antecedent, while an expressly cited complete2008 quotation establishes the same prayer-word sequence for this element. The existing word-exact flag is appropriate because the contract grades words rather than literal string typography. It does not assert photographic or punctuation identity. The compiler derives exact-target from a collated word-exact declaration with a cited finding; no runtime relaxation or new blanket grade is introduced.
exact_target_semantics.evidence: tools/mass-ordinary TARGET_WORDINGS contract and relation_of implementation were read directly; production side_text and complete calendar_structure were independently executed on the proposed source graph.
exact_target_semantics.strongest_source_counterargument: An official later quotation may not establish every property of the original altar-book page, and quotation pointing may differ from the quoted edition. It must not substitute for collation of a complete Missal or execution directions.
exact_target_semantics.answer: This acceptance is limited to the complete prayer words expressly quoted and attributed to the2008 Missal. It makes none of those page, rubric or whole-book claims. Source punctuation is retained and the reader note states the exact comparison route.

whole_expression_publication_assessment.finding: The whole uninterrupted prayer already occurs in the1862 printing. No phrase is assembled from another source, no petition clause or ending is changed, and no modern expressive recasting is reproduced. The new carrier is a faithful normalized transcription of that independently public-domain expression. The official modern quotation supplies comparison evidence only.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.strongest_adverse_argument: Official availability and a modern quotation convey no redistribution license for the modern book or journal, which retain distinct rights in their own contributions. A shared incipit or a list of old phrases would not establish that the displayed whole prayer is old.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.answer: The independently checked old page contains every word of this entire displayed prayer in one unit. Publication uses its source wording and pointing, without modern surrounding material. Modern PDF, page images, annotation, typography and rubrics are absent from the proposal. The affirmative basis therefore does not depend on an inferred modern license or on a vague assertion of antiquity.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.nature_of_assessment: Finite internal project source/publication assessment; no rightsholder permission, legal adjudication, liturgical approval or whole-edition clearance is claimed.
